```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
```

```{r importing data, message=FALSE}
# !!!NOTE: PLEASE SET THE NAME OF THE FOLDER CONTAINING csv FILES TO BE "data"!!!

Country_List <- read_csv("data/continents-according-to-our-world-in-data.csv")

GDP_pc <- read_csv("data/gdp-per-capita-worldbank.csv")

Youth_no_EET <- read_csv("data/youth-not-in-education-employment-training.csv")
```

```{r data cleaning and reforming}
GDP_pc_1 <- Country_List %>% select(-Year) %>% 
  right_join(GDP_pc, by = join_by("Entity", "Code"))
```
